sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the formula mapping before freezing. The candidate still uses nltl:span only in an unexplained equality with nltl:stringerSpan; that does not represent the declared span operand. Map and use every declared operand explicitly, while retaining nltl:stringerSpan for the verified l (stringer-span) role and nltl:distanceToAdjacentIceStringer for l_s. Also correct the unit conversion: designLineLoad is constrained in kN/m, while max(p*h,0.15) yields MN/m. Convert the derived line load to kN/m (or convert it back to MN/m before Z and A calculations) so the reported line-load value and both derived results use consistent units.
